notes.title: Update to our image policy and contents
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We are very happy to host such vibrant and engaged player in our steam community. 

After careful review of the feedbacks we received, we have decided to put in place 2 simple rules to the image contents in our community.

[list]
[*] No spoilers
[*] No nudity images.
[/list]

This is mostly because we want you to go over the process of unlocking the rewards and truly appreciate the game content as a reward.

See you in game!
The Booty Calls team
